summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric at 20 of 21 electric sites, 30 back-in sites to 56 ft, showers/flush toilets/dump/water, no camp store or laundry on site. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded (statewide table).
